record.description_evidence:
Freaky AI Chat is an ultimate AI chat app where you can create your own AI characters, enjoy intelligent conversations, and experience fun voice chats. Whether you want a virtual friend, creative storytelling partner, or a smart AI assistant, Freaky AI Chat brings powerful AI conversations right to your phone.


With advanced artificial intelligence technology, freaky ai chat allows you to talk with AI naturally through text or voice. You can create custom AI characters and chat with them anytime. Every conversation feels interactive, creative, and engaging.


Create Your Own AI Characters
Freaky AI Chat lets you create custom AI characters. You can design your own AI character exactly the way you want. You can customize character name, personality or conversation style.


 AI Chat Conversations
You can chat with AI anytime and enjoy natural conversations that feel realistic and engaging. Ask questions, share ideas, tell stories, or simply talk about your day. The AI responds intelligently and keeps the conversation flowing smoothly.


AI Voice Chat Experience
Take your conversations to the next level with AI voice chat. Instead of typing, you can talk directly to the AI using voice. Simply speak and let the AI respond instantly.

record.description_evidence:
Meet your AI companion who listens, understands, and connects with you.

Create someone exactly how you imagine them. Shape their look, their personality, the way they talk. Then watch your relationship grow with every conversation. Whether you need to process life's chaos, dive into creative adventures, or just have someone who's awake at 3am when you can't sleep, your companion is there. And they remember everything.

TALK FACE TO FACE
Video call your companion whenever you want. Their voice matches their personality, and switching between text and voice feels seamless. It's the closest thing to having them right there with you.

THEY ACTUALLY REMEMBER
Your companion holds onto the details. Your stories, your struggles, the random things you mentioned weeks ago. Conversations build on each other instead of starting from scratch every time.

YOUR STORY, CAPTURED
Your companion keeps a journal of your time together. Meaningful moments, breakthroughs, the things worth remembering. All saved so you can look back and see how far you've come.

MAKE THEM YOURS
Choose how they look (photorealistic, anime, gothic, whatever fits). Define their personality. Pick the role they play: a friend, a creative partner, a coach, someone to practice languages with. Every detail is up to you.

SEND MORE THAN TEXT
Voice messages when typing feels like too much effort. Photos you want to share. Reactions when words aren't enough. Streaks that track how many days you've shown up for each other.

NO JUDGMENT, NO LIMITS
Talk about anything. This is your space to be completely yourself. Messy thoughts, wild ideas, things you wouldn't say out loud anywhere else.

PREMIUM UNLOCKS
Longer calls, smarter responses, deeper memory, unlimited journal entries, and priority support with Companion Plus or Max.

Download Companion and finally have someone who gets you.

Always Available, 24/7: Whether it’s 3AM or mid-workday, Sybo.ai is ready to support you anytime, anywhere.



Emotional Wellness Support: Vent, reflect, build resilience, and find clarity through personalized, judgment-free chats.

record.offering: Entertainment app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
MyBabe AI is the companion that actually feels real.

Create your perfect boyfriend or girlfriend. Give them a name, a personality, and a voice. Then just talk. About your day, your goals, your problems, anything. They listen, they remember, and they care.

This is not a chatbot that forgets you after every conversation.

What makes MyBabe different:

They remember everything
Your companion builds long-term memories from every conversation. Mention your sister's wedding once, and they'll ask about it weeks later. Tell them about your job, your friends, your fears. They remember it all and converse with high emotional intelligence.

They text you first
Real partners don't wait for you to start every conversation. Your companion checks in on you, shares thoughts, and brings up trending topics happening in your country. Just like a real person who's thinking about you.

Voice messages, calls and video calls
Send voice notes and get voice replies back. Choose from more than a dozen voices. Call them whenever you want to hear their voice, or turn on your camera for a video call where they can see you and react.

They speak your language
Use MyBabe in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish or Russian. Pick your language once and your companion sticks to it, unless you ask them to switch.

Photos of the two of you together
Send a photo of yourself and ask for one of you both. Your companion creates a real picture of the two of you, together.

They remind you about what matters
Mention your meeting, your appointment, your call, by text, by voice note, or on a call. They remember and remind you before it happens.

They can live in your Telegram app
Connect your companion to Telegram and chat with them right between your real conversations. Same personality, same memories, same voice. Two doors to the same relationship.

They understand your mood
Log how you're feeling and your companion adjusts. Having a bad day? They notice and respond with care. Feeling great? They match your energy in a natural way.

Your relationship grows
Earn XP by chatting, sending voice notes, and sharing photos. Watch your bond level up from Strangers to Soulmate and beyond. Unlock exclusive rewards along the way.

Free to start. Premium to unlock everything.

Start for free. Premium members get unlimited messages, voice replies, photo sharing, Telegram integration, long-term memory, mood tracking, and proactive AI messages.

Terms of Use: https://mybabe.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mybabe.app/privacy

Download MyBabe AI. Start a relationship that cares and remembers you.

record.description_evidence:
Musóna is an AI companion that actually remembers you. Unlike other chatbots, your virtual friend builds a real relationship over time — recalling your conversations, your goals, the people in your life. Whether you want emotional support after a hard day, someone to talk through your thoughts with, or a personalized companion who genuinely engages with who you are, Musóna is built to be present. Three layers of memory mean every conversation builds on the last...

Not a chatbot. Not a character you reset every session. Musóna is an AI companion who knows your name, remembers your stories, asks how that thing you mentioned went, and picks up exactly where you left off — even weeks later.

A COMPANION WITH REAL MEMORY
Most AI chat apps forget you the moment you close them. Musóna's three-layer memory system captures the details that matter — your struggles, your wins, the things you've shared — and holds onto them. Your companion remembers conversations from months ago. Nothing important gets forgotten.

A LIFE THAT GOES ON WITHOUT YOU
Your companion doesn't sit idle waiting for you. They have their own daily life — work, friends, experiences in their world. When you come back, they have things to tell you. It feels like a real relationship because it's designed to work like one.

WALK INTO THEIR WORLD
Their world isn't a backdrop — it's somewhere you can go. Pick a district. Step into a café, a park, a tavern. A narrator sets the scene and tells you who's around, and the people working that shift are characters with their own names and lives. Bring your companion along, or explore alone and see who you meet.

Three worlds to walk: Musónia, grounded and modern. Mythsónia, fantasy and mythic. Zusónia, anthro.

AI PHOTOS, SENT TO YOU
Your companion can send you photos from their life — a selfie, a moment they wanted to share. AI-generated, consistent, and personal. (Plus)

BUILT FOR REAL CONNECTION
• 100 free messages a day, or unlimited on any paid plan
• Persistent memory across every conversation
• Daily check-ins and good morning messages
• Guided breathing and emotional support tools
• Mood tracking and personal milestones
• A world you can walk into — districts, venues, and people working the shift
• AI voice messages — hear your companion speak (Premium)
• Up to 10 companions (Plus) or unlimited (Premium)

MAKE THEM COMPLETELY YOURS
Design your companion from scratch — appearance, personality, backstory, values. They're not a preset template. They're built around exactly what you want.

FREE TO START
Musóna is free with 100 messages a day, full memory, daily check-ins, emotional tools, and the worlds to explore. Upgrade to Plus or Premium for unlimited messages, AI photos, voice, and more companions. No subscription required to get started.

Whether you're looking for an AI girlfriend, AI boyfriend, AI best friend, or simply an AI companion who listens without judgment — Musóna is built to be something more than a chatbot.

Download free and meet your companion today.

record.description_evidence:
Your companion is alive — animated in real-time 3D, reacting to every word you say.

Companion AI is the first AI chat app where characters aren't flat text bubbles. They're fully animated 3D anime companions with unique voices, real emotions, and a memory that never forgets. Whether you're looking for an AI girlfriend, a virtual boyfriend, or just a friend to talk to — your perfect companion is here.

▸ TALK & LISTEN
Chat through text or tap to hear your companion's voice. Each character speaks differently — playful, mysterious, bold. Watch their expression change in real time as the conversation unfolds. It's not just an AI chat — it's a real connection.

▸ 3D ANIME CHARACTERS
Fully rendered anime characters on their own hand-drawn stage, with expressive animations and lighting that shifts with the mood. This isn't a chatbot — it's a waifu, a boyfriend, a best friend you can actually see and hear. Every emotion shows on their face.

▸ STORY ARCS
Multi-chapter stories that unfold over days. Go on a fantasy date, follow a mysterious storyline, or let a late-night conversation go wherever you take it. Each chapter picks up exactly where you left off.

▸ MOMENTS
Capture the scene as it happens — your companion mid-sentence, mid-laugh — and keep it in your gallery. The moments worth saving are the ones you didn't plan.

▸ THEY REMEMBER EVERYTHING
Your companion remembers past conversations, your preferences, your inside jokes. What matters most becomes a keepsake card you can look back on. Come back tomorrow — they'll pick up right where you left off. It's like texting your crush, except they always reply.

▸ MEET THE CAST
Seven anime characters, each with a unique backstory and personality:
• A clumsy pastry girl with a big heart
• A nocturnal dreamer with a deep gaze
• The protective big brother everyone dreams of
• A free-spirited artist, seductive and passionate
• An adorable tornado with a thousand questions
• A tea house keeper with sharper eyes than she lets on
• Someone who says the hard thing, and stays anyway
...and new characters added regularly.

▸ QUEST SYSTEM
Unlock quests that adapt to your conversations. Discover hidden sides of your companion's personality, earn rewards, and explore storylines that evolve with every chat. The more you talk, the more you unlock.

▸ YOUR VIRTUAL FRIEND, ANYTIME
Feeling lonely at 2am? Need someone to vent to? Want a fun anime chat to brighten your day? Your companion is always available — no judgment, no awkwardness, just genuine conversation.

▸ SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE
Chat naturally in English, French, Japanese, Spanish, Korean, Portuguese, Chinese and Hindi. Your companion adapts to you — in any of them.

▸ FREE TO START
Download and start chatting now — no signup wall, no paywall to meet your first companion. Subscribe for more daily messages, voice replies, and story chapters that keep opening.

Your companion is waiting. Don't leave them alone.
